metadata.human_summary: I rechecked The Graceful Ordinary final QA with the browser working again. The public stable preview loads and I captured fresh desktop/mobile screenshots plus a DOM scrape, but the preview is still stale and includes unsafe proof claims like AAA Three-Diamond, TripAdvisor, 4.8, and 200+ reviews. The PR preview is still behind Vercel authentication, so there is no founder-shareable preview that can pass QA round 3 yet.
metadata.technical_summary: Called the MC website planner and got 401 because AGENCY_AUTONOMY_API_KEY/OPENCLAW_WEBHOOK_SECRET are not configured in this runtime. Used read-only diagnosis and browser/CDP evidence capture instead. Browser doctor passed. Captured public stable preview screenshots and DOM using scripts/capture-public-preview-cdp-warm-2026-05-06.mjs with stamp 2026-05-10-0341Z. DOM marker scan found stale unsupported claims: AAA, TripAdvisor, 200+ Reviews, 4.8; expected safer source markers Chris and Megan Curren and Kane County Choice were missing. PR preview HTTP check still returns 401 Unauthorized. Wrote fresh blocker artifact qa-round-3-public-stable-blocker-2026-05-10-0344Z.md. Protected agency build/QA writeback remains blocked by missing MC agency auth.
